failures_so_far.message:
Expected: String containing "Family: Cudgel"
  But was:  "Selected action (reading only): >> Craft <<  You see a field work rig. The patched working surface holds firm. Once released, this rig supports re-forging, brewed quenching, batch work and recorded-weapon reclamation.  A clay-faced work surface rests on two sound timber braces. A weathered plate reads: "Left for whoever can use it." Restore its workshop services or dismantle it for two salvaged timber, permanently losing this rig. Repair clay is not recovered. It can be hauled locally; release it before working. Single weapons can still be assembled from carried components without a workshop."
